SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_110
FROM sets s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.XCL_093 = s.XCL_099
      AND st.XCL_092 = 'Korean'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.XCL_093 = s.XCL_099
      AND st.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
)
